---
title: "sblr"
format: html
---

`sblr` is an experimental research package for scalable Bayesian linear
regression using individual-level packed genotypes or summary statistics with
sparse-LD and block-eigen operators.

Start with [Model overview](model_overview.qmd), then choose
[single-trait](single_trait_models.qmd) or
[multi-trait](multi_trait_models.qmd) models. The remaining pages describe
[annotations](annotation_informed_models.qmd), [`selection_s`](selection_s.qmd),
[operators](data_representations.qmd),
[convergence diagnostics](convergence_diagnostics.qmd), and
[workflows and outputs](workflows_and_outputs.qmd).
